name: camphor (natural) + methyl salicylate
purpose: Purpose Organic Methyl Salicylate 10%.....................Topical Analgesic Organic Camphor 4.0%................................Topical Analgesic
uses: Uses Temporarily relieves minor aches and pains of muscles and joints associated with simple backache, strains and bruises.
otcwarn: Stop use and ask a doctor if condition worsens symptoms persist for more than 7 days or clear up and occur again within a few days
